name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceLiveMallListH5Activity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens the web-based goods list from a live-shopping ad. It hosts the live promotion's product list and its item links.
disableEffect: The web-based product list for this live-shopping ad will no longer open.
